description: Sets the size of the window content area in CSS px. With the main process it resizes the real window; if the window cannot reach that size (smaller screen, kiosk, full screen), without the main process or with emulate=true, the page viewport is emulated at the exact size instead. Width and height 0 restore the window size.

emulate.description: Emulate the viewport without touching the real window

window.description: Window: target id from list_windows or part of its title. Optional when only one window is open.

name: resize_window
title: Resize window
